derivation_note: Reconstructed, not captured. The container envelope (data[0] with relationships.tracks.data) follows the parser read path in voicefox/source/src/apple/api.rs:335-357 (fetch_container_tracks) and musid-dli source_apple.rs container_tracks. Track rows reuse the upstream inline song values (api.rs:520-536); the album/playlist attribute values are placeholder samples.
request_note: GET /v1/catalog/us/{albums|playlists}/{id}?include=tracks&limit[tracks]=100 (musid-dli source_apple.rs container_tracks; upstream api.rs:339-343) — the same envelope serves both kinds, only the /albums/ vs /playlists/ path segment differs

empty_cases.note: empty data array → Error::NotFound (musid-dli container_tracks: ok_or(NotFound); upstream yields 'Apple Music 未找到该 {kind}' Other error, api.rs:344-347)
no data node at all → Error::NotFound on the same path

page_note: both upstream and musid-dli cap at limit[tracks]=100 and ignore paging for containers; playlist detail and album tracks always answer the first 100 tracks (upstream api.rs:341, musid-dli source_apple.rs container_tracks). The _page/_limit arguments are decorative.
